📖 How this report works

What it shows

Your vendors' addresses of one type (Main Office by default), with each vendor's contact details, as a sheet of address cards under their first letter. It is the BI version of the standard Vendor Address List and reads the same data the same way.

Each card is titled with the address's own name, as in the standard report. Click it to open the vendor.

Contacts

Under each address are the vendor's contacts of the chosen Contact type (Main by default): phone numbers, emails and so on. They belong to the vendor, so every address of a vendor lists the same ones, as in the standard report.

Using it
  • Filter changes apply straight away. Active vendors only by default; tick Inactive vendors to add (or, alone, to list only) the inactive ones.
  • State matches the state code (QLD, CA…) and Zip the postcode; use % or * as a wildcard (41% = every zip starting 41).
  • Click a letter's heading to fold it away; Expand / Collapse do every letter.
  • Cards is the standard label sheet; Table lists one address per row. The PDF view and Print are the 3-column sheet; Excel is one row per address.
  • In the Table view, click a column heading to sort the addresses within each letter (again to reverse, a third time for the standard order). Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it. While the Table view is shown, the PDF label sheet and Excel follow its sort.
  • Pivot counts the addresses by any two of first letter, vendor, state, country, city, zip and vendor status. Click a count to see the addresses behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the pivot on screen.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 addresses with a Load all button.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
